author: Marisol Ochoa
title: Riverside's Ant and Roach Shortlist, Before the Wind Season Cracks Widen - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago My house is a 1966 ranch with stucco cracked in more places than I've patched, and dry heat always pushes ants inside looking for water. Wind season finishes drying out the yard, and that's when the roaches show up too. As of late September 2026, I've watched three ant lines cross my kitchen this month alone. Time to see who's actually solving this, not just spraying it into hiding.
For this one I went through what's public — Google reviews for each business, at least 50 of them, a rating of 4.5 or better, something posted within the last year, all serving Riverside. I looked at BBB where I could find it. I couldn't confirm a license number for most of these, so I'm not claiming one exists beyond the one on record. Standard disclosure, and I mean it: no one on this list paid to be here, and I have no business relationship with any of them.
Have a pest control pro handle the ants . You share where you're seeing ants and roaches, and local pest control pros call to talk about a visit, free and no obligation. “Ants and roaches keep showing up in my house.” → Free for homeowners · Your number stays private 1. Compass Pest Management One reviewer says they haven't seen an ant since their first visit, after DIY sprays failed and a different company no-showed twice. 856 reviews strong and still sitting at 4.9, with one customer sticking around 10 years on quarterly visits. Ask for the same technician every visit — Richard, Jake, and Joe all get named repeatedly, and continuity seems to be half of why this one sticks for people with a real ant history, not a one-off spray.
2. HomeTeam Pest Defense This is the one with paperwork behind it — a state contractor's license on record, BBB accreditation since 2013, an A+ grade from the bureau. A five-year customer says there's nothing left, in the yard or the house. More than one reviewer credits Bert and Adrien for explaining the treatment before they start it, with 1,279 reviews behind that 4.9 rating. Ask for the CSLB license number and check it yourself before anyone touches your foundation line.
3. Moxie Pest Control Nobody else on this list touches Moxie's 1,532 reviews, holding steady at 4.7, and what stands out is how many people describe a technician stopping mid-job just to ask if they have questions. Axel gets named for that more than once; so does Johnnie, who recaps what he found before leaving. Roaches and ants need different treatment, bait versus spray, so snap a photo of where you're seeing them before you call and ask which method they're planning to use.
4. Akela Pest Control A customer of seven and a half years still calls Akela's service outstanding — a long time to stay loyal to a bug guy. Several others say the problem got handled on the first visit, then they signed up for monthly service after. Akela's smaller than the two above — 689 reviews — but the 4.8 average hasn't budged, and Aaron G, Robert Gregor, and Mark all get named for laying out the plan before starting. Photograph the trail before you call — it saves everyone the guesswork.
5. Unrivaled Pest Solutions of Riverside Fifty reviews is a small sample, but 5.0 across every single one is hard to ignore. One review boils down to seeing a lot of dead bugs after treatment, which made them very happy — I appreciate someone who says exactly what they mean. Sebastian gets singled out for taking his time instead of rushing a property in fifteen minutes, and a few reviewers point out the products don't harm bees or birds either. This is the newest, smallest name here, so ask how long they've actually worked your specific neighborhood before signing on for a recurring plan.
Which one to call Ants marching across the counter tonight? Compass, given that first-visit story. Want a license number you can verify yourself? HomeTeam. Roaches near the water heater? Moxie treats those differently than ants, so bring a photo of where you're seeing them. Older house where nothing's worked so far? Akela's first-visit record says something. Want a newer, smaller crew with a clean slate? Unrivaled.
If none of these fit what's actually crawling through your walls, describe it properly — where, how many, how long — and let the technician work from that instead of a guess at the curb.
